summary: This is a clipped MuleSoft documentation page for the DataWeave 2.6 function entrySet in the dw::core::Objects module. The function returns an array of key-value pairs describing the key, value, and attributes of an input object. The page is marked deprecated, and it points users to dw::Core::entriesOf instead. It includes a parameter description and an example that reads XML, calls entrySet, and shows the JSON output. Navigation, menus, and cookie text were ignored.
one_line: MuleSoft DataWeave 2.6 reference for the deprecated entrySet function, which returns an object's keys, values, and attributes as an array.
key_facts: The entrySet function is in the DataWeave 2.6 module dw::core::Objects.
The signature is entrySet<T <: Object>(obj: T): Array<{| key: Key, value: Any, attributes: Object |}>.
entrySet returns an array of key-value pairs that describe the key, value, and any attributes in the input object.
The only parameter is obj, described as "The Object to describe."
The entrySet function is marked Deprecated.
The page says to use dw::Core::entriesOf instead of entrySet.
The example reads the XML string 'true1' with application/xml into the variable myVar.
The example's source uses output application/json and returns { "entrySet" : entrySet(myVar) }.
For the example input, the output has one entry with key "xml".
In the example output, the entry's value is {"a": "true", "b": "1"} and its attributes are {"attr": "x"}.
The documentation page is from the DataWeave (2.6) reference, under DataWeave Reference, and is hosted in the mulesoft/docs-dataweave GitHub repository on the v2.6 branch.
The page footer shows the copyright notice "© Copyright 2024 Salesforce, Inc."
